# BLO-37287 — bound the wake-payload literal env value

Files:

- `src/server/job-manifest.ts`
- `src/server/job-manifest.test.ts`

`PAPERCLIP_WAKE_PAYLOAD_JSON` is classified `SAFE_LITERAL`, so it is emitted
as a literal `PAPERCLIP_WAKE_PAYLOAD_JSON=value` on the main container. Linux
caps each `execve` argument/environment string at `MAX_ARG_STRLEN`; an
oversized wake payload therefore killed the pod before the model turn and
could not report its own failure.

The adapter now keeps normal payloads unchanged and sheds oversized payloads
in two parseable tiers: first uncapped comment `metadata`/`presentation`, then
unbounded passthrough fields down to bounded routing identifiers. Both tiers
set `payloadShed`, `truncated`, and `fallbackFetchNeeded`, so the agent can
refetch rather than silently treating incomplete inline context as complete.
Tests cover the kernel-size invariant on every container, the tier-1 and tier-2
paths, non-vacuity, routing context preservation, and the normal-sized path.

The prompt threshold used by these tests is the superseding implementation
already present on `master` (commit `334ee4dac`); this change layers the wake
payload guard on top of it. The other unbounded `SAFE_LITERAL` JSON arrays are
tracked separately under [BLO-37868](https://paperclip.blockcast.net/BLO/issues/BLO-37868).
